claims.statement: Tom Allen did not come back to St. Louis from Chicago with Bauer on April 27, 1876, as had been expected.
claims.excerpt: Tom Allen did not come down from Chicago yesterday with Bauer, as was expected.

claims.statement: Chicago papers announced that Tom Allen contemplated taking up his permanent home in Chicago.
claims.excerpt: The Chicago papers announce that he contemplates taking up his permanent abode in that city.

claims.statement: Tom Allen's friends in St. Louis said he would certainly make a match with Joe Goss.
claims.excerpt: friends here state that he will certainly make a match with Joe Goss.

notes: The 'yesterday' of this paper dated 1876-04-28 is 1876-04-27. The Goss match is a friends' claim, not agreed. The wrestling news is about Bauer.
